title: Methods for producing an easily assembled zinc-air battery
author: Zhao, Liu, et al.

steps.title: Obtain and fabricate battery components
steps.instruction: Download the STEP files PP.STEP (pressing plates), BB.STEP (battery body) and BC.STEP (battery cover) from the Supplementary Material; 3‑D print the packaging components in polyamide‑12 (PA12) or injection‑mold them in ABS for alkali resistance.  Produce the metal accessories: an M4 stud, a square‑head bolt made by screwing an M5 stud into a copper block (7.5 × 10 × 3.8 mm), and a metal plate (12 × 30 × 1 mm).

steps.title: Prepare catalytic layer slurry
steps.instruction: Weigh MnO₂ (α‑type, ~200 nm, Shanghai Yunfu Nanotech), XC‑72R carbon black and 60 wt% PTFE emulsion in a weight ratio of 2 : 5 : 3; disperse them in a moderate amount of ethanol; roll‑press the resulting slurry to form a uniform catalytic layer.

steps.title: Prepare waterproof diffusion layer
steps.instruction: Mix XC‑72R carbon black, ethanol and PTFE emulsion in a weight ratio of 4 : 4 : 2 (ratio of carbon black to PTFE follows Ref. [14]); roll‑press the mixture to obtain a diffusion layer 0.3 mm thick.

steps.title: Form air‑cathode sandwich
steps.instruction: Place a Ni mesh or Cu mesh current collector between the pressed catalytic layer and the pressed diffusion layer; roll‑press the three‑layer stack to achieve a total air‑cathode thickness of 0.74 mm – 1 mm.

steps.title: Dry, cut and expose current collector
steps.instruction: Dry the assembled air‑cathodes at 60 °C for 30 min; cut them into plates of 112 × 72 mm; scrape the top surface of the catalytic and diffusion layers to expose part of the underlying current collector.

steps.title: Assemble zinc‑air battery with sealing
steps.instruction: Follow the substeps to build the sealed battery.

substeps.instruction: i. Screw the M4 stud and the square‑head bolt (with the M5 stud) into their designated holes on the top of the battery body (Step I, Fig. 2).
ii. Place silicone rings (SR.STEP) into the grooves on both sides of the battery body (Step II).
iii. Position the prepared air‑cathodes on each side of the battery body above the silicone rings; ensure the exposed current‑collector area contacts the square‑head bolt (Step III).
iv. Attach the pressing plates on both sides of the assembly and press them to immobilize the air‑cathodes via the built‑in mechanical fasteners, creating a closed internal space (Step IV).
v. Place the upper silicone ring (USR.STEP) on the top of the battery (Step V).

vi. Insert the metal plate into the hole of the battery cover, then attach the zinc foil anode (60 × 123 × 1 mm) beneath the cover; insert this cover‑assembly into the battery body and secure it with the cover; tighten the nuts on the bolts to fix the cover (Step VI).
vii. Inject 9 mol L⁻¹ KOH electrolyte through the liquid inlet hole; seal both inlet and outlet holes with silica‑gel plugs after filling (Step VII).
